messages:
lee_sales: Quick heads-up 11 LumenCare wants a HIPAA-capable POC. They projected peak chat traffic ~1200 qps (avg ~60 tokens) with most traffic concentrated in 5-minute morning spikes. Asking for recommended reserved sizing, a preheat plan, and a sample autoscale policy for pricing. Can infra confirm?

ara_eng: Thanks. Need clarification: are spikes abrupt (cold starts) or predictable (cron/marketing)? That affects preheat and burst sizing.

lee_sales: Predictable around 08:00-08:05 local, but could also have random 2-3m bursts. They want <250ms p99 on reserved capacity.

ara_eng: Rough calc: on our v-large (A100 perf) node, with model gpt-med-quant @60 tokens, a single GPU handles ~350 qps sustained. For 1200 peak we should reserve 4 GPUs plus 1 burst slot. Recommend reserved_gpus=4, burst_pool=1.

nina_sre: Agreed. Add KV shards aligned to GPUs (shards=8) and set preheat windows ~20m before predicted spikes. Also recommend AZ spread across 3 AZs for failover during maintenance.

tom_prod: Add degraded-mode model: gpt-med-compact with int8 quant for fallback to keep tail latencies <500ms. Route policy: prefer reserved -> burst_pool -> degraded_shared.

sara_ops: Preheat CLI example for POC:

```
# preheat KV + model weights
redwood preheat --project lumencare-poc --model gpt-med-quant --shards 8 --duration 20m --warm_weights true
```

ara_eng: For presales quote include this autoscale snippet (can be pasted into SOW):

```
autoscale:
  reserved_gpus: "4"
  burst_pool: "1"
  preheat_minutes: "20"
  kv_shards: "8"
  scale_up:
    policy: "aggressive"
    target_util: "65%"
    cool_down_s: "15"
  scale_down:
    grace_s: "240"
  degraded_model: "gpt-med-compact"
```

lee_sales: Can we state a conditional latency SLA for the POC? Customer wants something to sign.

ara_eng: We can commit: p99 < 250ms while on reserved_gpus=4 with KV warmed and no eviction. Note: if we serve from burst_pool or degraded_model, p99 may be 300-600ms. Add explicit caveats in the SOW.

nina_sre: Security checklist reminders for HIPAA: BAA signed, KMS envelope encryption, audit logs retention >=90d, VPC peering or PrivateLink, and optional on-prem connector for PHI. Legal_amy, can you confirm wording?

legal_amy: Will prepare standard BAA clause. Need to see their questionnaire — forward it and I'll mark items that need security annex. Also confirm they accept our log retention window.

sara_ops: Ops throttle knobs for safety: set global_rate_limit=1400qps and queue_depth_max=500 to prevent queue blowups. Also enable rate-based shedding under sustained overload.

tom_prod: Ill add telemetry hooks: automated alerts if p99 > 300ms for 2 consecutive minutes and automatic rollback to degraded_model if > 2m.

infra-bot: Preheat job scheduled (placeholder): lumencare-poc / preheat / 2024-12-05T07:40Z :rocket:

lee_sales: Great. For pricing: I'll put reserved_gpus:4 monthly commit with burst credits toggled on; note POC estimated cost = reserved baseline + variable burst usage. Nina, can you provide a ballpark daily run rate for the POC by EOD?

nina_sre: I'll pull numbers with finance and post an estimate. Expecting ~3-4x baseline per-day cost during heavy preheat days. :bar_chart:

lee_sales: Perfect. I'll bundle autoscale YAML + preheat cmd + SLA caveat into the SOW and send to LumenCare. Thanks team :pray:
